fit_rows: Exactly the 12 representation_fit tracks; no prototype, policy_train or heldout_selection tracks in fitting
prefix_schedule: Cycle p1/p2/p4/p8/p16 equally; no selected favorite prefix
positive_mask: Same legal Train Known category AND different physical track AND different video; never same-instance-only positives
augmentation_source: Fit batch only; same-seed identical perturbations for A1/A2; synthetic reliability target does not enter model inputs
loss: Both use identical cross-video supervised contrastive category loss; A2 additionally has 0.1-weight synthetic-corruption reliability BCE
evaluation: Same frozen pilot streams, four Known prototype tracks, four video orders, all five prefixes, recovered B1 arbitration and fixed .65/.55 cosine gates
calibration_caveat: The fixed gates are not guaranteed calibrated equally after adaptation; report this limitation, no learned-threshold or superiority claim
heldout_selection_use: Evaluation only after final fixed-step checkpoints; no early stop, hyperparameter search or fitting
scientific_claim: Tiny category/video-disjoint GT feasibility only; no main scientific PASS, M9 or M11 authorization
